title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.18278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. translated_title: 构建人工智能的信任：铁路应用的必然要求
translated_abstract: 由于铁路行业严格的标准和法规，人工智能（AI）目前仅应用于非安全关键领域。我们提出回顾三个主要领域，这些领域对于增强对数据科学和AI算法的信任并实现合规性至关重要：鲁棒性、运行设计域（ODD）和可解释性。鲁棒性是指AI系统在任何情况下都能保持其性能水平的能力（ISO24029）。ODD允许根据最新发布的DIN DKE SPEC 99004标准，明确定义系统预期运行的操作条件。可解释性是指AI系统以人类能够理解的方式表达影响AI系统结果的重要因素的属性。这三个研究领域已被非铁路行业的相关方深入研究，其算法和方法可直接用于铁路应用。要实现这一目标，需要从系统视角出发……
tldr: 该论文提出从鲁棒性、运行设计域（ODD）和可解释性三个关键领域入手，建立铁路行业对人工智能的信任并实现合规性，推动AI在铁路安全应用中的落地。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes to build trust in AI for railway applications and achieve regulatory compliance by addressing three key fields: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability.
